title: Blair Pavilion, Ipswich
axis: +X follows the photographed veranda toward west-northwest. +Z points north toward the road.
source: UniSQ’s August 2022 campus directory names the photographed building as Blair Pavilion, Building X. Its schematic perimeter was registered approximately using the published map scale and OSM Buildings H and T as controls. The University of Queensland identifies the Blair Pavilion as the 1907–1908 building with distinctive roof ventilators.

notes: UniSQ’s August 2022 campus directory names the photographed building as Blair Pavilion, Building X.
